name: ui-review
description: UI Review: review a website or app interface through 13 UI lenses at 360, 768 and 1280 px, and get a visual report with annotated screenshots plus a hands-off brief for AI agents.

plugins.name: ui-review
plugins.description: Review a UI for visual hierarchy, CTA prominence, imagery and icons, layout and grid, spacing rhythm, typography scale, colour and contrast, dark mode, brand coherence, design-system consistency, responsive behaviour, motion and perceived performance; measured values, annotated screenshots, a render-checked HTML report and a task file for AI agents.
